properties.description: A.I.LIENS - A 3rd Person Shooter RPG with Advanced A.I., Abilities, Player Stats, Inventory, Loot, Dialogue, Interaction, Firearms, Melee Weapons, Weapon Upgrades, Save/Load and much more\r\n
properties.short_description: Players engage in a battle against advanced alien forces, utilizing unique abilities and weapons to survive and uncover hidden truths.

short_descriptions.value: Spieler kämpfen gegen fortschrittliche Alien-Kräfte, nutzen einzigartige Fähigkeiten und Waffen, um zu überleben und verborgene Wahrheiten zu enthüllen.
Los jugadores luchan contra fuerzas alienígenas avanzadas, usando habilidades y armas únicas para sobrevivir y descubrir verdades ocultas.
Les joueurs affrontent des forces extraterrestres avancées, utilisant des capacités et armes uniques pour survivre et découvrir des vérités cachées.
Players engage in a battle against advanced alien forces, utilizing unique abilities and weapons to survive and uncover hidden truths.

properties.description: Incest Story: Sister is a visual novel for adult audience. You take on the role of a young guy who studies at a famous university. His sister enters the same university. A forbidden love quickly develops between the characters.\r\n
properties.short_description: A young man and his sister navigate their forbidden love while studying at a prestigious university.

short_descriptions.value: Ein junger Mann und seine Schwester navigieren ihre verbotene Liebe während ihres Studiums an einer renommierten Universität.
Un joven y su hermana exploran su amor prohibido mientras estudian en una universidad prestigiosa.
Un jeune homme et sa sœur naviguent leur amour interdit tout en étudiant dans une université prestigieuse.
A young man and his sister navigate their forbidden love while studying at a prestigious university.

properties.description: I AM PILL: A neon-drenched arcade challenge, testing dexterity and resolve. Master push-pull mechanics through increasingly difficult levels. Experience intense visuals, unforgiving gameplay, and themes of addiction and triumph in this psychedelic, precision-based journey. Rage, reset, conquer.\r\n
properties.short_description: A neon-drenched arcade challenge where players master mechanics to overcome levels themed around addiction and triumph.

short_descriptions.value: Eine neonbeleuchtete Arcade-Herausforderung, bei der Spieler Mechaniken meistern, um Level zu überwinden, die sich um Sucht und Triumph drehen.
Un desafío arcade bañado en neón donde los jugadores dominan mecánicas para superar niveles sobre la adicción y el triunfo.
Un défi arcade baigné de néons où les joueurs maîtrisent des mécaniques pour surmonter des niveaux sur l'addiction et le triomphe.
A neon-drenched arcade challenge where players master mechanics to overcome levels themed around addiction and triumph.

properties.description:
A fun and interactive way to learn the alphabet!

Now I know my ABCs 2, is a fun and interactive way to learn the alphabet. You're shown step-by-step how to write each letter. Your goal is to write every letter in both lowercase and uppercase. After you complete writing each letter a cool animation plays, giving positive reinforcement to help encourage the learning of even more letters!
